defects.what: the note loop reads fields[len(fields)]: every line with two or more fields panics
a quantity that is not a number is read as 0 with no error
the opened file is never closed
lines are added to Reserved without Reserve: no capacity check, no lock, negative quantities accepted
Get reads the map without the mutex Put holds: a data race
the expiry test is inverted: fresh entries are misses and expired ones hits
Release accepts any count: Reserved can go below zero and Free above Capacity
the last, partial page is returned as nil instead of its items
after every attempt failed it returns nil, not the last error
the pattern and paths go into a shell command line: command injection
